title: Roger Goodell expects NFL players to play flag football in the Olympics

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Roger Goodell expects NFL players to play flag football in the Olympics
sources.description: Broncos head coach Sean Payton said Tuesday he will be "surprised" if NFL players make the United States flag football team for the 2028 Olympics in Los Angeles.
